meta.stage: complete: prereg -> dev -> test(once) -> chat -> latency -> why -> verdict -> provenance

pre_registration.question: Can a mechanism that AGGREGATES ACROSS THE LOCAL NEIGHBOURHOOD (hyperbolic embedding, 0-dim persistent homology, graph-Laplacian spectral cut) or COMBINES MULTIPLE VARIABLES non-monotonically beat the single scalar cosine threshold nanomem ships for deciding which local candidates are competing revisions of ONE attribute?

baseline.name: shipped_default
baseline.definition: nanomem 0.3.0 / engine 3.0.4 at SHIPPED DEFAULTS on a re-opened vault, one isolated store per synthetic user, facts written with source='chat_session', no revision= argument, no metadata['entity'], temporal_direction left at its default 'current' (what chat.py and cli.py do). Identical construction to bench_temporal.py's run_nanomem(); the embedder is swapped for the shared cached nomic-embed-text table so every arm ranks identical vectors.
baseline.published_value: 90.5% top-1 over all 326 questions (scratch/refound/temporal_bench_results.json -> arms.nanomem_default); this harness re-derives it and the re-derived value is the one every delta is computed against.

equal_cost_control.name: shipped_wide_L
equal_cost_control.definition: the SHIPPED grouping mechanism with window_max raised from 4 to L, where L is the candidate budget the exotic arms are given. Every exotic arm is ALSO compared against this, so a win cannot come from seeing more candidates.

metric.primary: top-1 accuracy (the question's gold_id at rank 1)
secondary: per question type (adjacent_attribute, current_value, historical_value, previous_value, third_party)
p50 and p95 end-to-end Vault.search latency in ms

corpora.development: temporal_bench.json DEV split = users u01, u02 (65 questions, 91 documents). Every knob of every exotic arm is chosen here and nowhere else.
corpora.test: temporal_bench.json TEST split = users u03..u10 (261 questions, 365 documents). Scored ONCE per arm, after the DEV choices are frozen and written into this file.
corpora.third: clean_chat_benchmark.json, 3 audited personas, gold-store temporal verification, n=36. Regression guard: the shipped build scores 97.2% top-1 / 100.0% top-3 (scratch/refound/clean_chat_results_r5_3p.json).

seeds.store_and_ranking: deterministic given the fixed embedding table; the vault build is byte-reproducible, so 1 run per arm is exact, not a sample.
seeds.stochastic_components: the Poincare-ball fit (arm A) is initialised randomly; it is run with 3 seeds (0, 1, 2) and BOTH the mean and the full seed spread are reported. Spectral (arm C) and persistence (arm B) are deterministic. Arm D's logistic fit is deterministic full-batch gradient descent from a zero init.

decision_rule.win: paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 on top-1 against the shipped build at equal cost, on the TEST split
decision_rule.equal_cost_definition: equal candidate budget: the exotic arm and its control see the same top-L cosine candidates. Latency is reported; an arm whose p50 exceeds the shipped p50 by more than 20% is declared NOT equal latency and cannot be called a ranking win at equal cost however its CI lands.
decision_rule.regression_guard: an arm that clears the bar on the temporal TEST split but drops the 3-persona chat set below the shipped 97.2% top-1 is NOT recommended for integration.

arms.A: HYPERBOLIC. Fit the local pool (L candidates + the query) into a Poincare ball by stress minimisation against the doc-doc cosine dissimilarity, then cut the hierarchy by single-linkage on the HYPERBOLIC distance. PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTION: single-linkage is invariant under any strictly monotone transform of the distance matrix, so if the embedding fits well this arm is PARTITION-INERT and can differ from arm B only through EMBEDDING DISTORTION. The fraction of queries whose partition differs, and the Spearman correlation between hyperbolic and cosine distance, are reported whatever the accuracy does.
arms.B: TOPOLOGICAL. 0-dimensional persistent homology of the Vietoris-Rips filtration of the local pool = the single-linkage merge heights. Cut at the LARGEST PERSISTENCE GAP rather than at a constant, and keep the connected component containing the leader. This is the threshold-free version of WINDOW_DELTA.
arms.C: SPECTRAL. Normalised graph Laplacian over the local cosine affinity; split on the sign of the Fiedler vector and keep the side containing the leader. The Fiedler eigenvalue lambda_2 is the confidence: above a DEV-chosen value the neighbourhood is declared unsplittable and nothing is grouped.
arms.D1: MULTI-VARIABLE, MONOTONE CONTROL. Logistic membership model, LINEAR in (query gap g, doc-doc similarity s, log time gap dt, tag agreement). Fitted on DEV only. Isolates 'combining several variables' from 'being non-monotone'.
arms.D2: MULTI-VARIABLE, NON-MONOTONE. The same features plus g^2, s^2 and the g*s interaction. Fitted on DEV only. The fitted surface is MECHANICALLY CHECKED for a sign change of d f / d g inside the observed range of g; if no sign change exists the arm is reported as 'degenerate to monotone' and its result is not claimed as evidence for non-monotonicity.

pre_registration.what_counts_as_a_deliverable: A clean, well-powered NEGATIVE is a deliverable. Every arm run is reported, including the ones hoped to work, with its measured value.

arms.description: EQUAL-COST CONTROL. Shipped mechanism, window_max 4 -> 8, so no exotic arm can win merely by seeing more candidates.
(a) HYPERBOLIC, both decisions. Poincare-ball stress fit of the local pool, then the same 0-dim persistence cut on the hyperbolic distance.
(a) HYPERBOLIC at the tagged-floor decision only.
(b) TOPOLOGICAL, both decisions. Single-linkage / 0-dim persistent homology, cut at the widest barcode gap.
(b) TOPOLOGICAL at the tagged-floor decision only.
(c) SPECTRAL, both decisions. Fiedler bisection of the normalised Laplacian, lambda_2 gate at 0.8.
(c) SPECTRAL at the tagged-floor decision only. NOTE from DEV: lambda_2 there has median 1.38, so this gate NEVER fires and the arm is expected to be identical to T_shipped_floor_disabled.
(c) SPECTRAL at the floor with the gate raised until the cut actually fires (75% of calls on DEV).
(d) MULTI-VARIABLE, MONOTONE CONTROL: logistic in (g, s, dt, tag), fitted on DEV only.
(d) MULTI-VARIABLE + g^2, s^2, g*s. DEV check: NOT non-monotone in any argument over the observed range.
(d) MULTI-VARIABLE, VERIFIED NON-MONOTONE: full quadratic; d f / d dt changes sign inside the observed range.

CONTROL THAT DECIDES EVERYTHING: a one-line doc-doc cosine threshold nanomem ALREADY SHIPS, off by default, in exactly the place the exotic floor arms operate. 0.3/0.4/0.5 all tie on DEV; the most selective of the tied values is taken.
CONTROL: the query-relative floor simply deleted.

concurrent_library_edits.note: another workstream modified nanomem/arena.py, cli.py, engine.py and vault.py (arena growth / RSS) while this ran. The arms below were re-run against a clean checkout of commit 6aa6923 to prove the ranking path is unaffected.

quarantine.statement: This module never opened, scored, tuned on or diagnosed either quarantined fixture. No code path here reads them; they appear only in the FORBIDDEN list that _assert_quarantine() checks.

amendment_2026_09_16_verifier.why: A verifier found this study's headline -- 'no exotic arm clears the bar' -- true only against a control that was NOT pre-registered (vs_one_line_shipped_knob). Accepted. Nothing is re-measured; the arms are re-scored against the rule AS WRITTEN and then against the pre-registered regression_guard, which is what actually declines them.
amendment_2026_09_16_verifier.rule_as_written: paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 on top-1 against the shipped build at equal cost, on the TEST split
amendment_2026_09_16_verifier.how_they_are_declined: Not by the unregistered knob control. By the PRE-REGISTERED regression_guard: 'an arm that clears the bar on the temporal TEST split but drops the 3-persona chat set below the shipped 97.2% top-1 is NOT recommended for integration.' Every arm listed above drops it. The guard was written down before measurement and disposes of all of them on its own.
amendment_2026_09_16_verifier.what_the_knob_control_adds: An explanation, which should have been labelled as one rather than used as a bar: the arms that clear the win rule are rank-IDENTICAL on all 261 TEST questions to T_shipped_group_floor_sim_0.5 and T_shipped_floor_disabled -- a one-line threshold nanomem already ships turned off. They are not new mechanisms that happen to regress; they are that knob reached the long way round. Introducing a tighter control after seeing the numbers is a methodological defect even when it is conservative, and the conclusion should rest on the guard.
amendment_2026_09_16_verifier.corrected_headline: 6 arms clear the literal pre-registered win rule on the temporal TEST split. ALL 6 fail the pre-registered regression_guard on the 3-persona chat set. Verdict unchanged: SHIP NOTHING FROM THE MENU.
amendment_2026_09_16_verifier.quarantine_evidence_correction: This file's quarantine statement cited unchanged access times. That evidence is void: scratch/refound/quarantine_guard.py probe_atime() shows atime on this volume advancing with no read at all, then unchanged by a python read, cat and shasum. What stands is the source fact -- exotic_ranking.py opens none of the quarantined files, and _assert_quarantine() greps its own bytes to keep it that way -- plus the size/mtime/ctime non-modification witness in scratch/refound/quarantine_manifest.json.
